contract.selection: Development only: prefer negative-file FPR <=5%, highest recall, lowest threshold meeting the budget, then lowest FPR and two-hit confirmation. Provisional sensitivity policy addresses long-file extreme-score bias.

limitations: DEVELOPMENT-ONLY spectrogram experiment. Publisher recording labels; no fresh independent assessment, event timing, range or field-reliability claim.

metrics.event_metrics: Not assessed: publisher clip labels do not establish temporal truth

quality_advisory_coverage.interpretation: Uncalibrated input advisories, not measured wind/SNR or an accuracy/coverage improvement. Binary alarm decisions unchanged by flags.

training.objective: Positive bag: softplus(-max window logit); negative bag: mean softplus(window logit); balanced class and equal recording mass
